subject.title: Make agent identity preamble configurable (replace hardcoded 'personal assistant')

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow public main-agent prompt-identity config surface for replacing or suppressing the hardcoded identity opener?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but adding a durable identity opener knob affects public config, prompt authority, cache keys, docs, and upgrade expectations, so this needs maintainer product/API intent before implementation lands.

options.title: Accept identityLine/identityMode
options.body: Approve a backward-compatible opt-in config surface that preserves the default opener unless an operator explicitly customizes or suppresses it.

options.title: Route through broader prompt/context API
options.body: Reject the one-line identity knob for now and solve the need through a broader prompt/context customization surface such as context-engine or plugin contracts.

options.title: Keep current opener
options.body: Decline new core config and document supported SOUL.md, context, or prompt-extension mechanisms instead.

recommendation.title: Accept identityLine/identityMode
recommendation.body: Approve a backward-compatible opt-in config surface that preserves the default opener unless an operator explicitly customizes or suppresses it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest routing signal from recent prompt/config history and prior review context for this API decision.
